Anil is very good at making and flying kites, so he is called the King of Kites. His mother is very good at sewing, so she is called the Queen of Needles. They live in a village in India.

t: Anil wants to make twelve kites to fly at a wedding in the village.
His mother is busy sewing clothes for the wedding and needs his help, his ribbons and his sequins.
Anil has no time left to make his kites, but he does not get angry.
His friends remember the kites Anil made for them long ago and bring twelve kites to his house.
His mother helps him decorate the kites, and they fly high on the wedding day.

nota.t: Being helpful, obedient, patient, thankful, and valuing friendship.
Mowgli is a boy who grows up in the Indian jungle. He is raised by a family of wolves. His friends are Baloo the bear and Bagheera the black panther. Shere Khan the tiger wants to hurt him.

t: Values: friendship, courage, loyalty and caring for others.
Graphic novels tell the story with pictures, speech bubbles and captions.
